adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, explicitly appends other hosts’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the booking in `handleNewBooking.ts`, it only connects the first element: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`. This means only one `destinationCalendar` is stored on the booking (consistent with all other code still reading `booking.destinationCalendar` as a single object and then wrapping it into a one-element array). As a result, any later flow that reconstructs a `CalendarEvent` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (e.g., reminders/payments/confirm/editLocation in this diff) cannot recover the additional hosts’ calendars, so those destination calendars are effectively lost from persisted state.
